messages.subject: Strange behavior of open tabs in Tinn-R
messages.subject_clean: Strange behavior of open tabs in Tinn-R
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

With multiple tabs open in Tinn-R, when I switch from one tab to another, the text that is displayed often (usually) is for some part of the file other than where I last left my cursor. This forces me to find where I was just working, or results in my editing/copying/pasting in the wrong part of the file :(   Is there some setting that fixes this? Or is it a bug?

Thanks,
Len

messages.subject: Setting Comment Symbol
messages.body_plain: In Tinn-R 4.00.02 I cannot figure out how to set the comment symbol.  Does anyone know how to change it from the default?
messages.body_snippet: In Tinn-R 4.00.02 I cannot figure out how to set the comment symbol.  Does anyone know how to change it from the default?

messages.subject: Re: Setting Comment Symbol
messages.body_plain:
See the interface (Tools panel) Database/Comments.

Select the language and type the small pencil in the proper toolbar.

Other option (from main menu): Tools/Database/Comments

HTH,
